capabilities: Translate the active note into one of 11 languages
Save each translation as a new file, leaving the original untouched
Open the translation next to the source in a split pane
Generate interleaved bilingual copies with paragraph-by-paragraph translation
Switch between Google, DeepL and OpenAI-compatible engines
disambiguation: Not a bilingual reading view; it generates translated copies as new files.
extras: Interface is Chinese only. Note text goes only to the configured engine; no proxy server and no telemetry. API keys are stored in the plugin's data.json inside the vault.
problem: Translating a note in Obsidian means overwriting the original or copying it by hand, and pasted translations lose Markdown structure.

relations.evidence: Three engines: Google (no key required), DeepL, and any OpenAI-compatible LLM.
